Earth Song

An old chief has a dream about the Earth: how it was, and how it could become. Read the story, then work through all seven steps.

Read the story

Think deeper

There is no single right answer here. Write your answer in full sentences (at least 8 words). Then compare it with a sample answer.

Your own Earth Song

Imagine you are the old chief. Tonight you have a dream about the Earth in our time: in Israel, or in your town. Write what you saw, and what you will tell the people when you wake up.
Use at least 4 words from the story:
